TRIGGERED_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: As Hall of Triumph enters the battlefield, choose a color.

TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local chosenColour = GetChosenColour() if chosenColour == COLOUR_WHITE then LinkedDC():Set_Int(0, 1) elseif chosenColour == COLOUR_BLUE then LinkedDC():Set_Int(0, 2) elseif chosenColour == COLOUR_BLACK then LinkedDC():Set_Int(0, 3) elseif chosenColour == COLOUR_RED then LinkedDC():Set_Int(0, 4) elseif chosenColour == COLOUR_GREEN then LinkedDC():Set_Int(0, 5) end

STATIC_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+1.
Les créatures que vous contrôlez de la couleur choisie gagnent +1/+1.
Las criaturas que controlas del color elegido obtienen +1/+1.
Kreaturen der bestimmten Farbe, die du kontrollierst, erhalten +1/+1.
Le creature che controlli del colore scelto prendono +1/+1.
あなたがコントロールするその選ばれた色のクリーチャーは＋１/＋１の修整を受ける。
선택한 색을 가진 당신이 조종하는 생물은 +1/+1을 얻는다.
Находящиеся под вашим контролем существа выбранного цвета получают +1/+1.
As criaturas que você controla da cor escolhida ganham +1/+1.
由你操控的该色生物得+1/+1。
由你操控的該色生物得+1/+1。
STATIC_ABILITY.FILTER: local chosenColourInt = LinkedDC():Get_Int(0) local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE ) filter:Add( FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController()) if chosenColourInt == 1 then filter:Add( FE_COLOUR, OP_IS, COLOUR_WHITE ) elseif chosenColourInt == 2 then filter:Add( FE_COLOUR, OP_IS, COLOUR_BLUE ) elseif chosenColourInt == 3 then filter:Add( FE_COLOUR, OP_IS, COLOUR_BLACK ) elseif chosenColourInt == 4 then filter:Add( FE_COLOUR, OP_IS, COLOUR_RED ) elseif chosenColourInt == 5 then filter:Add( FE_COLOUR, OP_IS, COLOUR_GREEN ) end
STATIC_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: if FilteredCard() ~= nil then local characteristics = FilteredCard():GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Power_Add( 1 ) characteristics:Toughness_Add( 1 ) end
